ns2:course.label: Biomolecular Engineering
ns2:course.description: Fundamental principles of biomolecular engineering and its applications in pharmaceutical, agriculture, chemical and food industries. Topics include gene discovery, rational design, directed evolution, pathway engineering, and functional genomics and proteomics. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Chemical Engineering major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
